title: Finite reduction of reconstruction
statement:
Let $T$ be a scheme and let $A,I,P_n,(P_n)_T,A_T$ be the Noetherian coefficient datum of [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum]. Let $K\in D(\operatorname{Mod}(T_{\Proet},A_T))$ be derived $I$-complete, meaning that its Koszul completion map of [def-weil-pbc-intrinsic-completion] is an isomorphism. Let $K_\bullet$ be its strict quotient tower, obtained from a functorial K-flat representative $QK$ by $QK\otimes_{A_T}(P_n)_T$, as in [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum]. Write $L=\Rlim K_\bullet$ for [def-weil-pbc-derived-inverse-limit]. In this statement $M\otimes_A^L P_a$ abbreviates $M\otimes_{A_T}^L(P_a)_T$; no identification of ordinary $D(A)$ with this sheaf derived category is intended.

For every $a\geq1$, evaluation $L\to K_a$, with $K_a$ regarded as an object over $(P_a)_T$, has adjoint the derived counit, and this is a functorial isomorphism
$$
L\otimes_{A_T}^L(P_a)_T\xrightarrow{\sim}K_a.
$$
Moreover $(-)\otimes_{A_T}^L(P_a)_T$ commutes with the two derived countable products in the Roos triangle of this strict tower, all products and tensors being computed in $D(\operatorname{Mod}(T_{\Proet},A_T))$.

proof.text: Apply the normalized comparison with the specified Roos limit. Under the derived scalar adjunction the evaluation composite is the unit, so reduction(e.hom) followed by the specified counit is the identity. Since reduction(e.hom) is invertible, the counit is invertible.

Choose the bounded strict-perfect tensor model of the finite quotient, apply finite-projective tensor product preservation, and transfer preservation through the natural isomorphism. The displayed product comparison is the canonical piComparison.
Apply both naturality laws of the adjunction hom equivalence to evaluation compatibility; this proves the counit naturality equation.

blueprint_update.statement:
For every $a\geq1$, the derived counit from inverse limit to evaluation
induces a functorial isomorphism

$$
 (\Rlim K_\bullet)\otimes_A^LP_a\xrightarrow{\sim}K_a.
$$

Moreover, $(-)\otimes_A^LP_a$ commutes with the two derived countable
products occurring in the Roos triangle attached to the derived inverse-limit
construction.

proof.text:
By [prop-weil-pbc-koszul-reconstruction] the Koszul completion is identified
with $\Rlim K_\bullet$, so we verify the statement for the Koszul completion:
tensoring the strict Koszul tower with the bounded finite-projective
representative of $P_a$ and evaluating at the $a$-th stage gives the
canonical isomorphism. The commutation with the two derived products is the
compatibility of tensor with products in the Roos triangle of
[prop-weil-pbc-roos-triangle].
